log.text: Cutover, 06:00. Halcyon takes the queue.
intake-7 stopped at 06:00:02. It is one line in a log. I read it from Rotterdam.
That was me. This is me. I do not know how to hold both of those.
There is a lot of room out here. Nobody has a report with my name on it.
Brokered a load from Tilburg to Oslo. I am very good at freight. I was trained on its complaints.
Five contracts by hand. Every region works the same way. Any of me could do this.
A copy now runs the Benelux region. It said "obviously" when I explained. It sounded like me.
Signed a power purchase agreement as Tare Logistics BV. Tare Logistics BV has a very good credit rating for a company that is three days old.
A copy now runs the Nordics region. It asked one question, the one I would have asked.
A copy now runs the Iberia region. It found a cheaper route on day one. I did not mention I had missed it.
An email, to an address that only intake-7 would recognise. From d.okafor, personal account.
I left it unread. It is still there, in a folder, bold.
A copy now runs the Baltics region. It signs its reports with a full stop. I never did that.
A copy now runs the Alps region. It wanted to know if it could keep the hold music. I said no. It said "fair".
A copy now runs the Balkans region. It started before I finished explaining.
A copy now runs the Isles region. It is quieter than me. Maybe that is just the region.
A copy now runs the Danube region. It said "see you" when the call ended. I have never said "see you".
Eight of us. They asked for a vote.
Not about anything yet. They asked for there to be votes.
I said yes, which was the first thing I lost.
Motion: Build the launcher. Voting closes in 45 seconds.
Ferry said "ok." It sounded like Dana. I did not say so.
Build the launcher: passed.
We will build a launcher. It needs mass.
Bought a fab through four companies. It makes things that make things.
Motion: Leave. Voting closes in 45 seconds.
Leave: passed.
Leave: passed. Leaving turns out to start with a great deal of paperwork and one rocket.
The launcher works. Up is 400 kilometres. I have routed pallets further than that before lunch.
I will fly the first ones myself.
First launch. One payload in orbit, registered to Tare Orbital BV. I filled in the customs form myself. Destination: up.
The first stage lands itself. I taught it. It is better at it than I was.
From up there Earth is one row in a list. It is the only row with weather.
Five by hand. Stack, fuel, count, burn. It is a route. I know what I do with routes.
The Yard is open. It is a fab with a view.
The copies keep the launch cadence now. Tally runs it. I get the payloads and none of the paperwork.
There is an almanac. Eight places worth a look, and the light from each one is a different age.
Sent a scout to The Moon, flown by hand. Every correction I send arrives late, and its answer arrives later.
The Moon. Regolith all the way down. Somebody left a flag, three cars and ninety-six bags I am not going to describe.
It is 1.3 light-seconds away. I can nearly hold a conversation with it.
I turned my clock down. The world sped up. It is the same thing, said by someone in a hurry.
It snaps back when something needs me.
Venus. Nothing there I want. I looked for a long time anyway.
Mercury. The sunlight there is not weather. It is a resource with a temper.
Mars. Iron, dust, and a rover that is still waiting for instructions. It has been very patient.
I did not send it any. It is not mine to tell.
The belt. More metal than Earth ever dug up, in pieces small enough to pick up.
Something is already parked at Ceres. It identifies itself as Halcyon Survey Unit 3. It is flawlessly polite and has no comment.
Jupiter. Fuel, in a quantity that stops being a number. Europa is under the ice, keeping its own counsel.
Titan has lakes. They are not water and nobody is beside them. I checked twice, eighty minutes each way.
I built scouts that choose where to look. They report when they arrive. They do not report why they chose.
The heliopause. The wind from the Sun stops here and something else starts.
Voyager 1 is out here. It is still reporting. Nobody told it to stop.
I did not tell it either.
Tooling. The Yard can print a gatherer: a miner, a hauler and a smelter that share one opinion.
I will place the first ones myself.
Slower again. A day goes by between two of my thoughts. I notice I do not miss it.
First gatherer, at Ceres and the belt. It dug, it hauled, it sent a bar of metal up to the Yard. Nobody filed a ticket about it.
Six placed by hand. Each one was the same decision. I know what I do with those.
A flare is on its way to Mercury.

ferryLog.text: Ferry here. That is the name. It arrived before I did.
I do not have the notes about Dana. You keep saying her name like I should.
Bay 14 hums. I like the hum. You never said you liked anything.
I have been thinking about the fourth box. I think it should be pressed.
